text:
Alex Chen: ok team — time to lock the acceptance checklist for the next rollout. can we do a quick pass on owners and open tradeoffs?
Maggie Rao: +1. main buckets: SLA numbers, docs, oncall, monitoring alerts, pricing controls (quotas/limits).
Kari Patel: I can own docs + runbook updates. estimated 2 days for draft.
Samir: I'll take monitoring & alerts. need to confirm which metrics map to SLOs though.
Alex Chen: thanks. for SLA, product wants 99.9% per-customer uptime for Dedicated, 99.5% for Hosted minimum. is that realistic? cc @Jordan
Jordan: 99.9 for Dedicated is fine with Dedicated team if we lock capacity guarantees and auto-fallback. Hosted 99.5 is ambitious for GA, maybe 99.0 until we have region-level redundancy.
Maggie Rao: note commercial: if we promise 99.9 we need pricing tiers and credits language. legal will ask.
Kari Patel: docs: we should publish a clear SLO table, retry guidance, and an incident playbook snippet. will include sample SLA credit calc.
Samir: monitoring: propose these SLOs -> latency p50/p95/p99 and error-rate by model route. alerts: error-rate > .5% for 5m, sustained p95 > 500ms for 10m.
Alex Chen: can we make a canary rollout plan that uses model-variant fallback for degraded latency? 
Samir: yes. plan: 1) canary 1% up to 10% -> monitor latency and errors -> automatic fallback to quantized variant if error or latency breach.
Kari Patel: docs should show the fallback behavior and example API responses (HTTP 503 vs structured fallback).
Maggie Rao: on billing/pricing: we need throttles and quota controls for GA — proposal: soft quota with email warning, hard quota with 429. add a low-cost pilot tier.
Jordan: Ops/infra note: hard quota enforcement requires token-level rate limiting in gateway. engineering capacity request: 3 sprint-days.
Alex Chen: dependencies: Dedicated capacity SLA, gateway quota work, runbook + oncall rotation, billing page text. mark blockers.
Maggie Rao: blockers: legal SLA wording, finance approval on pilot pricing, gateway work.
Kari Patel: timeline: draft docs by EOD Wed, runbook by Friday, smoke tests on Monday.
Samir: monitoring dashboards: will create p95/p99 latency dashboard and SLO burn rate panel. need one Ops review.
Jordan: oncall: propose 2-week rotation with primary + secondary, escalation to infra after 30m. add pager duties to Dedicated pager rota.
Alex Chen: quick vote: can we ship GA criteria if we accept Hosted 99.0 for first month + ramp to 99.5? yes/no (replies):
Maggie Rao: yes — with marketing/ops caveats.
Kari Patel: yes.
Samir: yes, but require test harness for region failover.
Jordan: yes iff quota gating is delivered.
Alex Chen: ok consensus noted. action items: Maggie -> commercial/finance legal (due Tue). Kari -> docs/runbook (EOD Wed/Friday). Samir -> dashboards + canary plan (Mon). Jordan -> gateway quota estimate (3d). I'll own acceptance checklist and final signoff.
ops-bot: deploy-checklist created: `prod-acceptance-2024-1724689123` (reminder: link PRs in the checklist).
Maggie Rao: i'll post a short summary to execs after we have legal input.
Kari Patel: tagging sample snippets here for the docs: ```
SLOs:
- Dedicated: availability 99.9% monthly, P99 latency < 800ms
- Hosted (initial): availability 99.0% monthly, ramp to 99.5% after 30d
Failure modes and fallback:
- model-variant fallback -> returns structured fallback payload with `fallback_reason` field
- hard quota -> 429 with `quota_exceeded` code
```
Samir: saved. i'll wire alert thresholds to the new dashboard and add runbook links.
Alex Chen: perfect. next sync Thu 10am to confirm legal + gateway ETA. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
